main.description: Builds an ordered feed of flat item views from current indexed records for the registered feed and parameters selected in the request. Each item identifies its own record (uri, cid), its author, its kind and the time it is ordered by, and may carry the record's subject, engagement counts and card content, depending on the feed. The Hypercerts feed hydrates authors and card content; the experimental MaEarth feed returns merge metadata and counts only. Authentication is optional. When supplied, the AT Protocol service-auth issuer is the viewer and may omit params.viewerDid; anonymous requests must provide it.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request or the selected feed's parameters are malformed or semantically invalid.

errors.name: UnsupportedFeed
errors.description: The requested feed identifier is not registered by this service.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is invalid or incompatible with the selected feed.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.description: The service encountered an internal error.

feedId.description: Identifier of the feed algorithm to execute.

params.description: Algorithm-specific parameters. Omit when the selected feed accepts none.

limit.description: Maximum number of feed items to return. The selected feed determines the default and may enforce a lower maximum.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous request for this feed.

schema.description: Returns ordered feed items and an optional cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted when no later page is known.
